# Conveyor

Conveyor is a platform that automates security reviews by providing a Trust Center, AI-driven questionnaire automation, and integrations with various tools to streamline compliance processes.

Category: Security & Ops. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/conveyor/.

## Actions

- **Create new authorization**: Create a new authorization.
- **Delete a Conveyor document**: Delete a specific document.
- **Delete folder**: Delete a folder by its ID.
- **Generate/Validate API Token Guidance**: Validate API token and provide guidance.
- **Get all authorization requests** (read-only): Retrieve all authorization requests.
- **Get all Conveyor connections** (read-only): Retrieve all connections.
- **Get all Conveyor documents** (read-only): Retrieve all documents.
- **Get all Conveyor folders** (read-only): Retrieve all folders.
- **Get Authorization Request** (read-only): Fetch details of a specific authorization request.
- **Get Authorization Requests** (read-only): Fetch authorization requests.
- **Get interactions by document ID** (read-only): Fetch interactions associated with a specific document.
- **Get Knowledge Base Questions** (read-only): Retrieve knowledge base questions.
- **Get product lines** (read-only): Fetch all product lines.
- **Patch authorization**: Update or revoke an existing authorization.
- **Patch Conveyor document**: Update document attributes.
- **Submit single question**: Submit a single question.
- **Upload new document**: Upload a new document.
- **Create new folder**: Create a new folder in Conveyor Exchange.
